title: Neosyn's Basic Magic
description: Basic and simple magic added to minecraft, very easy to use and not big!
body:
# ✨ Neosyn's Basic Magic ( Only version ever

A magic mod made with MCreator!
This mod is all about magic, spells, and new items to explore in your Minecraft world.

You also need to download mcreatorlink: https://mcreator.net/link/download/MCreator%20Link%201.3%20[1.19.4].jar

## 🪄 Features
### 🔮 Spells

- Flyio – Lets you fly for a short time.

- Buleso – Shoots a powerful laser beam that deals heavy damage.

- Swish – Dash forward with extreme speed, but gain darkness and drop to 1 heart 

- Shadow – Travel to the shadow realm for 10 seconds, in the shadow realm your safe and cant be killed or harmed

- How to make spells, craft a spell maker and follow the build in recipes of the spellmaker, then via the spellmaker instert the spell items

### 🛠️ Custom Items

- Wand – Crafted using a Core and Enforced Sticks.

- Enforced Stick – Crafted with 4 sticks.

- Core – Crafted with 2 coal, 2 gold ingots, and 1 emerald.

### 🏰 Custom Structures

- Magic Ruins – Appear across many Overworld biomes, though not too common.

⚒️ Technical Info

Built with MCreator

Inludes compatibility files so it works with both Minecraft and MCreator
